mapper.sql: lea.achievement_id as "achievementId", lea.achievement_id::text as "managementNo", lea.target_user_id as "targetUserId", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id) as "teacherName", lea.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", lea.occurred_date as "occurredDate", lea.achievement_detail::text as "achievementDetail", lea.certification_status as "certificationStatus", (lea.attachment_ref is not null) as "hasAttachment", lea.created_at as "createdAt", lea.updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.select:
select from lecture_evaluation_achievements lea join users u on u.user_id = lea.target_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
order by lea.occurred_date desc, lea.achievement_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
select count(*) from lecture_evaluation_achievements lea join users u on u.user_id = lea.target_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no
select count(*) from evaluation_organization_mappings eom where eom.user_id = #{actorUserId} and eom.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' and eom.data_scope in ('BUSINESS', 'ALL')

select count(*) from input_period_settings ips where ips.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and ips.area_code = 'EDUCATION' and ips.user_type_code = 'FACULTY' and ips.active_yn = 'Y' and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP between ips.start_at and ips.end_at

select eds.start_at::date as "startDate", eds.end_at::date as "endDate" from evaluation_date_settings eds where eds.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and eds.area_code = 'EDUCATION' and eds.user_type_code = 'FACULTY' and eds.active_yn = 'Y' order by eds.start_at desc, eds.setting_id desc limit 1

select count(*) from evaluation_element_management_item_settings eems where eems.management_item_code = #{managementItemCode} and eems.evaluation_year = #{evaluationYear} and eems.area_code = 'EDUCATION' and eems.item_code = 'LECTURE' and eems.active_yn = 'Y' and eems.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y' and eems.evaluation_confirmed_yn = 'N' and CURRENT_DATE between eems.effective_start_date and eems.effective_end_date

insert into lecture_evaluation_achievements ( evaluation_year, target_user_id, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, certification_status, created_by, updated_by ) values ( #{evaluationYear}, #{targetUserId}, #{managementItemCode}, #{occurredDate}, cast(#{achievementDetailJson} as jsonb), 'DRAFTING', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} ) returning achievement_id as "achievementId", achievement_id::text as "managementNo", target_user_id as "targetUserId", (select coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id) from users u left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no where u.user_id = target_user_id) as "teacherName", management_item_code as "managementItemCode", occurred_date as "occurredDate", achievement_detail::text as "achievementDetail", certification_status as "certificationStatus", (attachment_ref is not null) as "hasAttachment", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt"
mapper.insert: insert into education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, reason_code, opinion, processed_by, processed_at, created_by, updated_by ) values ( #{history.achievementType}, #{history.achievementId}, #{history.previousStatus}, #{history.nextStatus}, #{history.actionType}, #{history.reasonCode}, #{history.opinion}, #{history.processedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} )

insert into data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id ) values ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId} )
